thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 11/01/2018: MAXR, FIT, SPOT

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/01/2018: MAXR, FIT, SPOT
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks

GOOG +0.05%
Technology stocks were firming in recent trading, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding more than 0.7% while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 4%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(-) Maxar Technologies ( MAXR ) fell 6.3% on Thursday after the networking equipment company Wednesday reported non-GAAP Q3 net income and revenue trailing analyst forecasts and prompting downgrades by analysts at least two brokerages.
In other sector news:
(+) Fitbit ( FIT ) was almost 27% higher Thursday afternoon after the smart-watch company reported a Q3 non-GAAP profit of $0.04 per share, reversing a $0.01 per share net loss during the year-ago period and beating the Capital IQ consensus also expecting a $0.01 per share net loss.
(-) Spotify Technology SA ( SPOT ) dropped 6.2%. The music streaming service reported a surprise Q3 profit, posting net income of EUR0.23, or about $0.26, per share compared with a EUR1.84 per share net loss during the same quarter last year and topping the Street view expecting a EUR0.30 per share net loss.
